messages.subject: Bru DIC/WAIC classic vs experiemental
parts:
Hi, 

I am working on a preferential sampling model (and a simpler LGCP for testing) in inlabru and have noticed the strange DIC/WAIC behavior mentioned in this tutorial. (Running R 4.2.1, INLA 22.12.03, and inlabru 2.7.0 and I recover same values in classic & experimental mode as published in the tutorial)

I know this is ongoing, but am curious if in the meantime, you have recommendations for model comparison or words of advice/caution about which mode to use or which aspects of model output to be wary of. Experimental mode has been performing better on simulated data for my application, but I see the tutorial went ahead with the classic mode DIC values for model selection. 

Any insights you can offer would be greatly appreciated! 
Thanks, 
Hanna
